_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Chemical Safety Program Plan
summary: This plan is required from Army contractors engaged in research and development work, or production contracts which require the use of chemical agents or research, development, test and evaluation (RDTE) dilute solutions of chemical agent.
description_purpose: This plan is required from Army contractors engaged in research and development work, or production contracts which require the use of chemical agents or research, development, test and evaluation (RDTE) dilute solutions of chemical agent.
application_interrelationship:
This data item description contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This plan describes the contractor's organization program and procedures for meeting DoD, Army and major subordinate command safety requirements for use, handling, storage, and disposal of chemical agents.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The program plan shall be prepared in the following narrative format and shall include the requirements identified below:

children.title: Description of Contractor Facility
children.content: to include drawings of all work sites with CSM/dilute solution areas specially noted to include location of ventilation systems, hoods, storage areas; policies which describe the procedures and equipment used to satisfy the Surgeon General's requirements for all agent areas, associated ventilation and agent handling systems; test data verifying adequacy of all associated ventilation and agent handling systems; test methods for periodic recertification of the associated ventilation and agent handling systems.

children.title: Storage, Handling and Use of CSM/dilute solutions.
Personal Protective Clothing and Equipment
children.content: (policies for selection, use and testing of personnel protective clothing and equipment) for CSM/dilute solutions.

children.title: Waste Disposal
children.content: (policies and procedures for disposal of any chemical agent/dilute solutions to include verification of clean-up efforts for both liquid and solid waste).

children.title: Policies and procedures for the establishment of Standing Operating Procedures
children.content: for each area and operation unique to any specific contract, to include storing, transferring, manufacturing or use of chemical surety material/dilute solutions.

children.title: Safety Training Program
children.content: for all individuals with access to chemical agents or RDTE dilute solutions of chemical agent.

children.title: Chemical Accident/Incident Response Assistance (CAIRA) Plan
children.content: containing procedures for controlling accidental release of agents for maximum credible accident scenarios to include the orderly evacuation of personnel from areas in the contractor facility.

children.title: Medical Plan
children.content: which describes the effects of the particular chemical agent involved, symptoms of exposure, first aid procedures, methods of decontamination, use of protective clothing and equipment, and procedures to be followed in the event of a spill or other emergency situations.

children.title: Specific Safety Provisions
children.content: (standards and procedures which are used in conjunction with good laboratory practices to provide safe and healthful working environment for employees; detailed policies for storage, handling and movement of chemical agents, including dilute solutions; procedures for controlling release of agents).

children.title: Waiver provisions
children.content: to include justifications and test data verification.

children.title: Revisions to Safety Program Plan
children.content: (policies and procedures for Safety Program Plan revisions to include new contract requirements and SOPs for the specific work conducted).

children.title: Reclamation Requirements
children.content: (procedures and policies for the release of decontaminated material and/or equipment in support of other nonrelated chemical agent operations).
